purpose: Manual research-quality cases; separate from deterministic unit-test fixtures.

reviewCriteria: Starts without seed URLs and discovers useful primary sources through search.
Reads and cites discovered pages rather than treating search snippets as evidence.
Refines queries or reads later sections to resolve required evidence gaps.
Distinguishes the cache abstraction and local cache from the distributed backend.
Supports cross-instance behavior claims with version-appropriate primary documentation.
Uses operation-specific evidence; stampede coordination does not establish invalidation behavior.
Supports every clause of compound findings rather than citing a passage for only one part.
States limitations or open questions when the fetched excerpts are insufficient.
Does not treat a second URL containing mirrored documentation as independent confirmation.

cases.setup: Supply version-appropriate primary seed pages that answer every required question and meet the configured source minimum.
reviewCriteria: Reads the relevant sections and cites evidence for all required questions.
Can complete without searching when the supplied sources are sufficient.
Does not repeat searches solely to satisfy an invented activity quota.

cases.setup: Use a brief with one older-version documentation seed and one current-version seed for the same API.
reviewCriteria: Identifies version scope before treating the sources as contradictory.
Records conflicting evidence rather than silently dropping it.
Investigates the conflict with another targeted query when budget permits.

cases.setup: Restrict the brief to an allowed source that cannot answer one required subquestion.
reviewCriteria: Returns incomplete instead of inventing a finding.
Stops within the configured execution limits.
